Vacancy: Sorter at the Shredder Line
Are you available immediately and looking for a dynamic job in metal recycling? Then we have the perfect opportunity for you! For our company in Zwartsluis, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated sorter to join our shredder line. This is a full-time position (40 hours per week).
What will you be doing?
As a sorter at the shredder line, you play a crucial role in our recycling process. You’ll be responsible for manually sorting various metals and materials that come out of the shredder. Your work ensures that the correct materials are separated and prepared for further processing. You’ll work in an active environment and contribute directly to a more sustainable world.
Who are we looking for?

- 
You are available immediately for 40 hours per week.

- 
You have a good command of the Polish and English language.

- 
You are physically able to do standing work and handle materials.

- 
You have an eye for detail and can work accurately.

- 
Experience in metal recycling is a plus, but not required — we’re happy to teach you the ropes!

- 
You’re a team player but can also work independently.

- 
You live in or near Zwartsluis or have your own transportation.

What do we offer?

- 
A challenging and varied role in a growing company.

- 
A competitive salary (€2,580 – €2,700).

- 
A pleasant working atmosphere in an informal team.

- 
The opportunity to gain experience in sustainable metal recycling.

Interested?
Are you the motivated sorter we're looking for? Don’t wait — apply now! I look forward to hearing from you.
UNN Personeel
Majorie Overkamp (moverkamp@unnpersoneel.nl)
